title: Machine Learning Beyond Statistical Consistency for Hybrid AI
abstract: arXiv:2611.01914v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose a new definition of machine learning, according to which a machine learns a function when it computes the function successfully, that is, when the value it returns for each input has a proper derivation in a formal system. We extend G\"odel's Representability Theorem, which equates computation with derivation, to empirical targets in two ways: the theorem is extended to the computable reals, and the data are admitted into the system as empirical definitions that record what has been observed. We prove that a machine learns a true probability if and only if two conditions are met. The Truth Condition is that its estimate converges to the true probability, which is statistical consistency. The Assurance Condition is that the machine properly derives its own convergence inside the system. translated_title: 面向混合人工智能的超越统计一致性的机器学习
translated_abstract: 我们提出了机器学习的一个新定义：当机器成功计算一个函数时，即它对每个输入所返回的值在形式系统中都具有适当的推导时，该机器就学会了这个函数。我们将哥德尔可表示性定理（该定理将计算与推导等同起来）在两个方面扩展至经验目标：一是将该定理扩展到可计算实数，二是将数据作为记录已观察内容的形式化定义纳入系统。我们证明，机器学会一个真实概率当且仅当满足两个条件：真值条件，即其估计收敛于真实概率，这也就是统计一致性；以及保证条件，即机器在系统内部正确推导出自身的收敛性。因此，学习超越了统计一致性，因为它还要求能够从记录中推导出收敛性。
tldr: 该论文提出机器学习的新定义，证明机器学会一个真实概率不仅需要统计一致性（真值条件），还需要机器能在形式系统内部正确推导出自身估计的收敛性（保证条件），从而将学习的标准置于统计一致性之上，为混合人工智能奠定形式化基础。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a new definition of machine learning, proving that a machine learns a true probability if and only if both statistical consistency (the Truth Condition) and an internal formal derivation of its own convergence (the Assurance Condition) hold, thereby placing learning beyond statistical consistency for hybrid AI.
